description: Use when the user asks: 'find me X', 'who or what is X?', 'find any record of X', 'a song about X'. Use when the entity type is not yet known. Convenience fan-out across works and creators — runs list_works and list_people with the same query and returns the union. No cross-type ranking; prefer list_works or list_people when the entity type is known. → then: directory_lookup_work (work details), directory_lookup_person (creator details, by the result's global_creator_id)

human_made_only.description: Works only: keep works the owner declared human-made that ACRCloud does not call likely AI-generated.

query.description: Search query — matches work titles, ISWCs, creator names, ISNIs

type.description: Limit results to a specific entity type
